message.content: CI is red on main. Can you look at the lint job?

content.content:

  --> src/store.rs:88:31

88 |         let key = encode_key(&id.to_string());
   |                               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ help: change this to: `id.to_string()`
   |
   = note: `-D clippy::needless-borrow` implied by `-D warnings`

error: could not compile `tally` (lib) due to 1 previous error

content.text: CI treats clippy warnings as errors. The needless_borrow lint fires at src/store.rs:88 because encode_key takes an impl AsRef<str>. Removing the borrow fixes it.
